scenario.name: r-cd-in-recovery-queued-restart
scenario.description: A queued typed delegate input snapshot survives an operator gateway restart and is handed to the child from durable state with identical snapshot identity.
scenario.notes: Runnable harness, orchestration-gated verdict. The gateway restart is an operator step the harness must not perform; without OPENCLAW_RESTART_ORCHESTRATED=true the row is PARTIAL-candidate by construction.

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.send dispatch accepted for the delayed attachment-bearing delegate

expectedReceipts.name: input-snapshot-queued
expectedReceipts.description: CDINREC-QUEUED sentinel with the staged byte total, emitted while the delegate is still queued

expectedReceipts.name: post-lifecycle-child-arrival
expectedReceipts.description: CDINREC-CHILD-ARRIVED sentinel observed after the operator restart window

expectedReceipts.name: snapshot-identity-preserved
expectedReceipts.description: Arrived byte total equals the queued byte total: the child got the durable snapshot, not a re-read

expectedReceipts.name: no-raw-attachment-bytes-on-the-wire
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: queued attachment content absent from every non-harness frame

expectedReceipts.name: no-pre-lifecycle-spawn
expectedReceipts.description: Negative check: the delayed delegate did not spawn before its queue window elapsed

review.notes: PARTIAL-candidate is the expected artifact class unless an operator actually restarted the gateway inside the queue window. The scenario records the precise reason in evidence.orchestration.reason; a PASS without an observed restart must be rejected at fold.

liveRunSafety.notes: Requires an operator gateway restart during the queue window (OPENCLAW_QUEUE_DELAY_SECONDS, default 120). The harness never restarts anything. Set OPENCLAW_RESTART_ORCHESTRATED=true only when a restart genuinely happened.
